REPORT zreg_families.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_field,
         fieldname TYPE c LENGTH 30,
       END OF ty_field.

DATA shipment_ref TYPE string VALUE 'global'.
DATA name TYPE string VALUE 'global'.
DATA: BEGIN OF gt_items OCCURS 0,
        id  TYPE i,
        qty TYPE i,
      END OF gt_items.
DATA gv_total TYPE i.
DATA gv_weight TYPE p LENGTH 13 DECIMALS 3 VALUE '12.5'.
DATA gv_text TYPE c LENGTH 20.
DATA gv_unit TYPE c LENGTH 3 VALUE 'KG'.

CLASS lcl_asn DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             shipment_ref TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_value.
    TYPES ty_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_value WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mv_p_basuni TYPE string VALUE 'KG'.
    METHODS get RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
    METHODS ref RETURNING VALUE(rv_ref) TYPE string.
    METHODS sync CHANGING ct_values TYPE ty_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_asn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get.
    rs_data-shipment_ref = 'ASN-1'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD ref.
    DATA lo_asn_clone TYPE REF TO lcl_asn.
    DATA lv_shipment_ref TYPE string.
    lo_asn_clone = NEW #( ).
    lv_shipment_ref = lo_asn_clone->get( )-shipment_ref.
    rv_ref = lv_shipment_ref.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD sync.
    IF ct_values[ name = 'P_BASUNI' ]-value <> mv_p_basuni.
      ct_values[ name = 'P_BASUNI' ]-value = |{ mv_p_basuni }|.
    ENDIF.
    RETURN.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

START-OF-SELECTION.
  DATA lo_asn TYPE REF TO lcl_asn.
  DATA lt_values TYPE lcl_asn=>ty_values.
  lo_asn = NEW #( ).
  WRITE / lo_asn->ref( ).
  lt_values = VALUE #( ( name = 'P_BASUNI' value = 'G' ) ).
  lo_asn->sync( CHANGING ct_values = lt_values ).
  WRITE / lt_values[ 1 ]-value.

  gt_items-id = 1.
  gt_items-qty = 2.
  APPEND gt_items.
  gt_items-id = 2.
  gt_items-qty = 3.
  APPEND gt_items.
  LOOP AT gt_items.
    gt_items-qty = gt_items-qty * 10.
    gv_total = gv_total + gt_items-qty.
  ENDLOOP.
  WRITE / gv_total.
  READ TABLE gt_items INDEX 2.
  WRITE / gt_items-qty.

  PERFORM get_costcenter.

  WRITE gv_weight TO gv_text UNIT gv_unit.
  WRITE / gv_text.

FORM get_costcenter.
  DATA: lt_fields  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field WITH DEFAULT KEY,
        lt_options TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_field WITH DEFAULT KEY.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_field>  LIKE LINE OF lt_fields,
                 <ls_option> LIKE LINE OF lt_options.

  APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_options ASSIGNING <ls_option>.
  <ls_option>-fieldname = '...'.
  APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_fields ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
  <ls_field>-fieldname = 'KOSTL'.
  LOOP AT lt_fields ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
    WRITE / <ls_field>-fieldname.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.
